## Foods & dishes
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈400 Danish recipes (region "Scandinavian"); not released. [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 230 tagged `danish`. [[CulinaryDB]]: "Scandinavia" 404 (no split).
- Dish inventories: [[WorldCuisines]] 22 dishes (6 Denmark-only; rugbrød, rullepølse); [[FmLAMA]] 16 dishes (188 rows; risalamande, koldskål); [[World Wide Dishes]] 1. Ingredient lists only.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table for this country is in the vault or `Backlog/`; use [[USDA FoodData Central]] (and [[FooDB]] / [[Phenol-Explorer]] for compounds) by name matching.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 131 plants (Greenland 13 separately).

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- **Human-cohort evidence:** [[Exposome-Explorer]] 802 rows (311 concentrations, 384 correlations, 28 cancer, 26 metabolomic). Inter99 and DCH give intake–biomarker correlations; OPUS (New Nordic Diet) gives 26 food → metabolite rows.
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 9 records; [[KNApSAcK Family]] World lists the country (edible/medicinal species records; counts for European countries were not scraped).
- Global backbone via [[Global]]: [[FooDB]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[CTD]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions.

## Gaps
- No Danish FCT (Frida) and no Danish recipe corpus.
